climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A large Victorian zone where Pinot Noir leads plantings at 38 percent, followed by Chardonnay (20) and Shiraz (18). Vines cover only about 460 acres across a wide area, in a state with more wine producers than any other in Australia.
